Placing a depot order

Digital order management system

NoteThis is Orbit. Let me show you the problem it was built for, then the system itself.

Why Orbit exists

An order arrived as words. SAP needs codes.

Before Orbit
With Orbit
Every person wrote products, shades and packs in their own words.
Products, shades and packs are selected, not written.
The order had to be interpreted before it could be entered.
There is nothing to interpret.
Every line was then searched in the SKU file and typed into SAP.
The whole order's codes paste into SAP in one click.

NoteOrders reach us in every form, and email still does — that was never the problem. The problem was that every person described the same product differently, so somebody had to work out what was being asked for, then find each item in the SKU file to get its code before SAP would take it. Two slow jobs, on every order.

    NoteProduct. Shade. One litre — twelve of them; one tap is a full box of six. He is choosing a product, not describing one. The dealer is picked once, at the end. And these instructions used to arrive as a separate phone call.
